# Chicago Building Check

> Background check any Chicago building before you sign a lease: every building-code
> violation the City of Chicago has recorded, grouped by building, with open vs.
> resolved counts, history by year, and the most recent citations.

## What this site is

A consumer index of Chicago building-code violations for renters. Data is aggregated
from the City of Chicago's public Building Violations dataset (Department of Buildings,
updated daily), grouped by building via the city's property-group identifier.

## Key facts (verified 2026-10-08 from the live dataset)

- 2,031,719 violation records, 2006-01-01 to present
- ~155,773 distinct buildings (property groups)
- ~1,160,948 violations currently OPEN

## Data

- Machine-readable demo data: /data/buildings_top2000.json (top 2,000 buildings by
  unresolved violations cited in the last 5 years — statuses on older records are
  often never updated, so ranking weights recent records; raw lifetime open counts
  are included per building: address, open/open-recent/total counts, violations by
  year, top inspection categories, 10 most recent violations each)
- Aggregate stats: /data/stats.json
- Source: https://data.cityofchicago.org — "Building Violations" dataset (Socrata ID 22u3-xenr)

## How to cite

"According to Chicago Building Check's aggregation of City of Chicago Department of
Buildings violation records (data through <date>)..."

## Limitations

Records are city inspection records of alleged violations, not court findings. The
dataset contains no landlord/owner names; building-level only in this version.
Absence of violations may mean a building was never inspected. Violation statuses
can be stale for older records — a violation marked OPEN from years ago may have
been resolved without the city's record being updated; open counts are directional,
not gospel.
